Name: Ryor Hats
Author: RavengerMRIB
Description:
This is a small mod I had originally made for personal use that I thought others might enjoy.   It adds Five (5) new hats to the hat shop.  

[size=4][u]Installation [/u][/size][list=1]
[*]Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/index.php?title=Modding:SMAPI_compatibility&oldid=74245#Json_Assets]Json Assets 1.2+[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip the file and place [JA] Ryor Hats into the [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[u][size=4]Optional Installation[/size] 

[/u]Due to clipping issues with all hair styles, I have included with this file a Hairstyles.XNB.   This files features an alteration I made to the 12th hair option making it shorter cropped, removing clipping issues.   To install...
[list=1]
[*]Go to [i]Stardew Valley/Content/Characters/Farmer[/i]
[*]Backup the existing [i]Hairstyles.XNB[/i] to a folder of your choice
[*]Copy/Paste the modded [i]Hairstyles.XNB[/i] to this folder and replace the existing file
[/list]
As I said, this only alters the 12th hair option and leaves all other vanilla options untouched.  This will however, not work with any mod that alters or replaces this file.  To my knowledge there isn't any way to add new styles to the game, so I apologize if this is an issue.  

I recommend using a mod that allows for the alteration of appearance in game so you can change to the nonclipping style when wearing these hats and then back to your preferred style when not.  
To my knowledge the mod itself shouldn't conflict with anything.  

This is only my second mod, so if you have any comments or suggestions, feel free to leave then in the posts section.  Thank you.
